fee_notes: Royalty: 7% of monthly Gross Revenue or Minimum Royalty Fee (whichever is greater). Minimum Royalty escalates from $15/unit months 1-4 to $3,000/month or $15/unit (month 56+). Brand Development Fund: 1% of Gross Revenue or $2/month per Unit managed (whichever greater). Technology Fee: $150/month. Required Business Tools Fee: $975/month (covers CRM, accounting, property management software). Keyrenter Marketing Fee: $925/month. Local Advertising Requirement: $1,425 or 3% of prior month Gross Revenue (whichever greater). Additional fees for non-compliance ($25/day), system modifications (up to $5,000/year, $50,000 term limit), and other services.
